 Fort Bend County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0015
 Tanya Henson, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
5-31-24
Counsel for defendant:
Richard Marshall, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant generally denies each and every allegation contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition and, pursuant to Rule
92 of the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure, demands strict proof thereof by a preponderance of the evidence.
For further answer, and without assuming any burden of proof that the law places on Plaintiff, Defendant asserts the
following affirmative defenses.
First, Plaintiff's own negligence caused or contributed to the collision. Plaintiff failed to keep a proper lookout, failed to
confirm that the adjacent lane was clear before moving, and failed to yield the right of way as required when cahnging
lanes. Under Chapter 33 of the Texas Cviil Practice and Remedies Code, any recovery must be reduced by Plaintiff's
percentage of responsibility, and Plaintiff may be barred if that percentage exceeds fifty percent.
Second, the injuries and damages claimed were caused, in whole or in part, by a pre-existing condition, a subsequent
event, or the acts or omissions of a person or entity other than Defendant, for which Defendant is not liable.
Third, Plaintiff failed to mitigate damages by failing to follow reasonable medical advice and by failing to seek or
continue treatment reasonably available to Plaintiff. Any recovery must be reduced accordingly.
Defendant reserves the right to amend this answer as discovery proceeds.
</page>

  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
